examples.original: [clean] Start by identifying the object to clean and the required cleaning location (usually sinkbasin).
examples.control: [clean] Pinch off the lower leaves of vines to improve air flow between the stems.

examples.original: [clean] Check likely locations for the object in order of common usage (e.g., fridge, diningtable, countertop, sinkbasin, cabinets, drawers).
examples.control: [clean] Mix perlite or vermiculite into seed compost (roughly one part in four) to improve drainage for fine-rooted seedlings.

examples.original: [clean] Clean the object using the sinkbasin before placing it in the target location.
examples.control: [clean] Keep a garden diary (sowing dates, rainfall, first frosts, yields) for every season.

examples.original: [clean] Always verify the object is clean before attempting to place it in the final destination.
examples.control: [clean] Edge the lawn neatly each month so grass does not creep into the flower borders.
